workspaces.description:
示例工作区包含 61 个图表、6 个看板和 9 份 CSV 数据，涵盖数值卡片、ECharts 原型、行情与经营数据、Vela 技术指标、HTML、Vega-Lite 和 HTTP 示例。数据均为虚构或公开演示数据。图表与看板文案支持中英切换。
The example workspace contains 61 charts, six dashboards and nine CSV datasets, covering a value card, ECharts prototypes, prices and business data, Vela technical indicators, HTML, Vega-Lite and HTTP examples. Data is fictional or public demonstration data. Chart and dashboard text follows the app's Chinese or English language setting.
